quotations.old_english: Ðonne he gást ofgifeþ, syððan hine (?) gærsbedd sceal wunian
quotations.english: when he gives up his spirit, then must he inhabit a grave

source_text: gærs-bed, -bedd, es; n. A grass-bed, grave; sub cæsp&i-short;te lectus, sepulcrum :-- Ðonne he gást ofgifeþ, syððan hine (?) gærsbedd sceal wunian when he gives up his spirit, then must he inhabit a grave, Ps. Th. 102, 15.
